title: New York City's 2015 Street Tree Census: every street tree, its species, diameter, status and health
provider: New York City Department of Parks and Recreation, on NYC Open Data (Socrata): 2015 Street Tree Census - Tree Data (uvpi-gqnh)
credit: 2015 Street Tree Census: NYC Department of Parks and Recreation, NYC Open Data
licence: NYC Open Data's Terms of Use; the dataset's licence field is empty (checked 2026-11-12), and New York City's Open Data Law (Local Law 11 of 2012) publishes its datasets without restrictions on their use.
citation: New York City Department of Parks and Recreation (2016), 2015 Street Tree Census - Tree Data, NYC Open Data, https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/uvpi-gqnh
format: CSV of the columns asked: tree_id, tree_dbh (inches), status (Alive, Stump, Dead), health, spc_latin, spc_common, latitude, longitude, boroname, nta, nta_name.
coverage: The street trees of the five boroughs, counted by volunteers and staff in 2015-2016: about 684,000 records.

all.description: Every record, the columns above (about 75 MB)
